title: Google Home Couldn't Communicate
shortDescription: Google Home app cannot reach the device.
fullDescription:
This message appears when the Google Home app can't establish a connection to the speaker.

Most often it's a network issue: phone and speaker on different subnets, router blocking multicast, or temporary Google service issue.

fixSteps.title: Same network
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure phone and speaker on same WiFi.

fixSteps.title: Enable multicast
fixSteps.instruction: In router settings enable IGMP snooping/multicast.

faq.a: Yes, disable VPN while setting up.

title: Google Home Not Set Up
shortDescription: Device visible but not completing setup.
fullDescription: Google Home app sees the device but cannot complete setup. Possible causes: wrong Google account, outdated app, Bluetooth disabled on phone.

fixSteps.title: Enable Bluetooth
fixSteps.instruction: Turn on phone Bluetooth and location.

videoSearchQuery: Google Home not set up fix

faq.a: Switch account in the Google Home app.

title: Google Home WiFi Connection Failed
fullDescription:
WiFi connection failures come from wrong password, weak signal, or unsupported security (WPA3).

Move closer to router during setup and confirm WPA2.
videoSearchQuery: Google Home WiFi connection failed fix

title: Google Home Factory Reset Needed
fullDescription:
The app may request a factory reset if the device is linked to another account or is in a stuck state.

Hold the mic mute button 15 seconds on Mini, or factory reset button under the Home.

fixSteps.title: Hard reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold reset/mic mute button 15 seconds per model.

faq.a: Yes, device returns to out-of-box state.

title: Google Home Something Went Wrong
fullDescription: Google Assistant says something went wrong, try again in a few seconds. Usually transient cloud or network hiccups.
videoSearchQuery: Google Home something went wrong fix

title: Google Home Chromecast Error
fullDescription: Cast fails when mDNS discovery is blocked, phone and speaker are on separate networks, or Google Play services on phone are outdated.

fixSteps.title: Same network
fixSteps.instruction: Verify phone and speaker on same SSID.

faq.a: Enable in device settings for cast without same WiFi.

title: Google Home YouTube Music Error
fullDescription: YouTube Music playback fails when account isn't linked, free tier restricts playback, or subscription family sharing is misconfigured.
videoSearchQuery: Google Home YouTube Music error fix

title: Google Home Cast Not Working
fullDescription: Cast failures often arise from isolated networks, outdated Google Play services, or firmware mismatch on the speaker.

faq.a: Sometimes yes for casting across networks.

title: Google Assistant Not Responding
shortDescription: Speaker does not react to Hey Google.
fullDescription: Not responding to wake word can be caused by mic mute, retrain needed with Voice Match, or connectivity issue.

title: Google Home Spotify Account Error
shortDescription: Spotify linking fails or returns error.
fullDescription:
Spotify account errors occur when linking token expires or account is shared across too many devices.

Re-link the Spotify account in Google Home app.

fixSteps.title: Re-link Spotify
fixSteps.instruction: Home app > Settings > Services > Music > Spotify > Unlink and link again.

videoSearchQuery: Google Home Spotify account error fix

faq.a: Both work but on-demand requires Premium.

title: Google Home Firmware Error
shortDescription: Firmware update fails or device shows firmware error.
fullDescription:
Firmware errors on Google Home/Nest devices normally self-correct when the device retries the update overnight.

Leave the device plugged in and connected to WiFi. If it persists, a factory reset is recommended.

fixSteps.title: Leave plugged in
fixSteps.instruction: Keep device on WiFi overnight to retry.

title: Google Home Radio Error
fullDescription:
Radio playback (TuneIn, iHeart) may fail when the station stream is unavailable or the default news/radio service is misconfigured.

Change the default service or specify the station provider.
